lines.zh: 缓慢挪动，眼中光芒闪烁。

lines.en: Staring at you, emitting a deep hiss.

lines.zh: 盯着地面，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: Staring at the ground, seeking a target.
Roaring, the sound vibrating the air.

lines.zh: 向前缓慢行走，注意四周。
发出低沉的咆哮，似乎在寻找什么。
慢慢靠近，发出轻微呼吸声。
脚下的岩板被烤得发红。
lines.en: The stone under me glows red.
Every step leaves a scorch mark.
I pace along the lava lake.

lines.zh: 热浪把我身边的空气扭歪。
lines.en: Heat bends the air around me.

lines.zh: 沉重的身体压得地面发颤。
lines.en: My weight makes the ground tremble.

lines.zh: 凝视远方，眼中闪烁着光点。
lines.en: Staring into the distance, eyes flickering.

lines.zh: 三秒一次，我把火球砸出去。
lines.en: Every three seconds another fireball leaves my hand.

lines.zh: 偶尔转动头部，观察四周。
lines.en: Occasionally turning its head, surveying the surroundings.
Fixing you with its gaze, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 静静地等待，耐心如磐石。
lines.en: Patiently waiting, as still as a stone.

lines.zh: 低头观察，寻找食物的迹象。
lines.en: Bending down to look for signs of food.

lines.zh: 三秒一到，我就抛下一颗爆弹。
lines.en: Every three seconds, I drop another bomb.

lines.zh: 偶尔移动，寻找更好的位置。
lines.en: Occasionally moving to find a better spot.

lines.zh: 盯着你，时刻准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Staring at you, ready to attack at any moment.
A ball of fire rests in my palm.
Blue flame dances between my fingers.
The lava pool mirrors my shape.
Fire rolls deep in my eyes.
I wait for the call to sound again.

lines.zh: 迅速转头，寻找你的踪迹。
lines.en: Turning its head quickly to find you.

lines.zh: 盯着你，似乎能看穿你的皮肤。
lines.en: Staring at you as if seeing through your skin.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，直视你的心脏。
lines.en: Its gaze like a torch, staring at your heart.
Staring at you, ready to attack at any moment.

lines.zh: 目光坚定，盯着你的每一步。
lines.en: Steadfast gaze, watching every step you take.

lines.zh: 盯着你，仿佛能预见你的行动。
lines.en: Staring at you, as if预见 your actions.

lines.zh: 目光如刀，盯穿你的盔甲。
lines.en: Gaze like a knife, piercing through your armor.

lines.zh: 盯着你，准备发出致命一击。
lines.en: Staring at you, ready to deliver the fatal blow.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，照亮你的每一寸。
lines.en: Gaze like a torch, lighting up every inch of you.
Your fire reflects in my eyes.
I stare at you, and the flames leap.

lines.zh: 闪烁着蓝光的身体开始摇晃
身上开始冒出奇怪的烟雾
它的目光变得越来越模糊
你靠近了，熔岩的怒火将你吞噬！
lines.en: You get close, the lava's rage will consume you.

lines.zh: 我的光芒能照见黑暗，但不欢迎入侵者！
lines.en: My light sees through the darkness, but not invaders.

lines.zh: 靠近的你，将会尝到熔岩的滋味！
lines.en: You get close, taste the lava.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，熔岩会欢迎你的接近！
lines.en: Stay back, lava will welcome you.

lines.zh: 我的光芒可以驱散黑暗，但不能改变你的命运！
lines.en: My light drives back the dark, but not your fate.

lines.zh: 你诱惑我，将付出沉重代价！
lines.en: You tempt me, at a great cost.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我会用熔岩欢迎你！
lines.en: Don't come close, I'll greet you with lava.

lines.zh: 熔岩是我的武器，也是我的家园！
lines.en: Lava is my weapon, my home.

lines.zh: 你诱惑我，我会回报你同样的热情！
lines.en: You tempt me, I'll return your passion.

lines.zh: 靠近我，将面临熔岩的惩罚！
lines.en: Come near, face the lava's wrath.

lines.zh: 你手里的呼唤之物在响。
lines.en: The calling thing in your hand hums.

lines.zh: 三秒后，我脚下这块会炸。
lines.en: In three seconds, the stone under me bursts.
Do you want to be ash too?

lines.zh: 你碰到了我，会有更多熔岩！
lines.en: You touched me, more lava will come.

lines.zh: 你撞上了我，熔岩将随之而来！
lines.en: You collided with me, lava follows.

lines.zh: 你撞我了，熔岩会淹没你！
lines.en: You collided, lava will drown you.

lines.zh: 不要碰我，我有熔岩作为武器！
lines.en: Don't touch me, I have lava.

lines.zh: 你撞我了，会有更多的伤害！
你碰我了，会有熔岩溅出！
你撞到了我，熔岩将包围你！
你碰到我了，会有更多伤害！
你撞我了，会有更多的熔岩！
不要靠近我，我会用熔岩回应！
lines.en: Don't come near, I'll respond with lava.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，才能繁衍后代！
我需要伴侣来延续种族！
lines.en: I need a partner to continue the species.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，才能繁衍后代！
伴侣是延续种族的关键！
lines.en: A partner is key to the species.

lines.zh: 找我作为伴侣，才能繁衍！
lines.en: Find me as a mate to reproduce.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣决定了种族未来！
lines.en: My mate decides the species' future.

lines.zh: 我需要伴侣来延续生命！
lines.en: I need a partner to continue life.

lines.zh: 熔岩围绕着我，我屹立不倒。
lines.en: Lava surrounds me, but I stand firm.

lines.zh: 下方的岩浆池是我的摇篮。
lines.en: The lava pool below is my cradle.

lines.zh: 我以熔岩为食，永不饥饿。
lines.en: I feast on lava, never hungry.

lines.zh: 熔岩之石，我的灵魂之源。
熔岩的炽热是我力量的源泉。
lines.en: The heat of lava is my power source.
I draw life from the lava.
My statue, a witness to immortality.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，也够盯住你。
lines.en: One eye is enough to keep you in sight.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着观察者之呼唤，对吧。
lines.en: You hold the Observer's Call, don't you.
The bomb is already away; run.

lines.zh: 三秒一发，你逃不出范围。
lines.en: One shot every three seconds — you can't outrange me.

lines.zh: 我的存在将化你为灰烬。
lines.en: My presence will turn you to ash.

lines.zh: 火舌舔上我的石壳，很烫。
lines.en: Flames lick my stone shell; it burns.

lines.zh: 坠落的冲击让它发出一声惊叫
在水中挣扎的它发出微弱的叫声
爆炸的冲击让它四散飞溅
被飞来的物体击中后它摇晃了几下
被魔法击中后身体开始扭曲
掉入虚空的它发出一声哀鸣
